description.en: The audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported.

description.zh: 是否启用声码，若传入了true，必须传入参数SoundCodeConfig，否则调用会失败。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable sound codes. If you set this parameter to true, you must also pass the SoundCodeConfig parameter. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.

><notice>

description.en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must pass this ID value. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If no ID value exists, you do not need to pass it.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh: 项目ID，是项目的唯一标识，您可以通过[项目管理控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects)获取项目ID。如果没有项目，可以创建项目后获取项目ID。
description.en: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of a project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management Console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects). If you do not have a project, create one and then obtain its project ID.

description.zh:
声码配置，包含字段如下：


- **SoundCodeContent**：声码营销内容，例如商品的详情地址等。

- **AdditionalDuration**：语料播放结束后的声码播放时长，单位为秒，取值范围为1～15。
description.en:
Sound code configuration, which includes the following fields:


- **SoundCodeContent**: Marketing content embedded in the sound code, such as a product detail URL.

- **AdditionalDuration**: The playback duration of the sound code after the speech material ends, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 15.
The speech rate. Valid values: -500 to 500.

description.zh:
语料类型，分为自定义语料和常用语料。

> 不传入此参数时或传入**custom**，必须传入参数Text，否则调用会失败。

- 自定义语料（默认）：取值为**custom**，是自定义语料时，必须填写语料标识和语料文本。
- 常用语料：由系统预置的常用语料文本，包括以下类型：
    - 数字：取值为**number**，包含：数字0~9，点，幺。
    - 量词：取值为**measure_word**，包含：个，十，百，千，万，十万，百万，亿等。
    - 货币单位：取值为**monetary_unit**，包含：分，角，元等。
    - 时间单位：取值为**time_unit**，包含：时，分，秒，月，日，年等。
    - 单位时间：取值为**unit_time**，包含：每秒，每分，每小时，每天，每周，每月，每年等。
    - 长度单位：取值为**length_unit**，包含：毫米，厘米，分米，米，千米，公里，英寸，英尺，英里等。
description.en:
The type of speech material, which can be either custom or preset.

> If this parameter is not specified or is set to **custom**, the Text parameter must be provided; otherwise, the invocation will fail.

- Custom speech material (default): Set to **custom**. When using custom speech material, you must specify both the material identifier and the text content.
- Preset speech material: System-provided common speech texts, including the following categories:
    - Numbers: Set to **number**, including digits 0–9, "point", and "yao" (a colloquial term for "one" used in Chinese contexts).
    - Measure words: Set to **measure_word**, including terms such as "ge", "shi", "bai", "qian", "wan", "shi wan", "bai wan", "yi", etc.
    - Currency units: Set to **monetary_unit**, including "fen", "jiao", and "yuan".
    - Time units: Set to **time_unit**, including "shi" (hour), "fen" (minute), "miao" (second), "yue" (month), "ri" (day), and "nian" (year).
    - Unit time expressions: Set to **unit_time**, including "per second", "per minute", "per hour", "per day", "per week", "per month", and "per year".
    - Length units: Set to **length_unit**, including "millimeter", "centimeter", "decimeter", "meter", "kilometer", "gongli" (Chinese term for kilometer), "inch", "foot", and "mile".

description.zh: 语料文本，当语料类型选择为自定义语料时，该参数必选。语料文本支持英文字母、汉字和空格，长度为1~100个字符，一个汉字占两个字符。
description.en: The speech text. This parameter is required when the speech type is set to Custom. The text can contain English letters, Chinese characters, and spaces. The length must be 1 to 100 characters, where one Chinese character counts as two characters.

description.zh: 语料播报声音，由系统预设，例如标准女声、标准男声等。可以选择的声音类型通过[GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~)进行查询，填入返回参数中`VoiceList`中`Value`的值。
description.en: The voice used for speech synthesis, which is predefined by the system, such as Standard Female Voice or Standard Male Voice. You can query available voice types by calling [GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~) and use the `Value` field within the `VoiceList` response parameter.
The volume level. Valid values: 0 to 100.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为2。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 2.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot test-speech --voice Siyue --volume 50 --project-code 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --speech-rate 0 --text test --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --speech-type custom --audio-format wav --sound-code-config AdditionalDuration=3 SoundCodeContent=www.taobao.com --enable-sound-code true --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot TestSpeech --region cn-hangzhou --SoundCodeConfig '{"AdditionalDuration":3,"SoundCodeContent":"www.taobao.com"}' --SpeechType custom --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --Volume 50 --EnableSoundCode true --ProjectCode 4de2c36700008c585e599200 --Text test --AudioFormat wav --Voice Siyue --SpeechRate 0
